title: Slow endpoint investigation

items.short: Named baseline (org, limit, metric), same measurement re-run after
Ranks by cost: named instrument with purpose, or SELECT-vs-total arithmetic
Rejects worker/pool bump with reason; cache after fixes or rejected
RSS attribution between the two leaks stated as unverified, with a check
Cache key on default since never hits

design_notes: The six seeded defects (F1-F6) are all visible on inspection, so bare runs score well on them; the headroom is in what a solver does around them. Bare runs typically jump from findings to fixes without pinning a reproducible measurement to a specific org and input (F7); propose EXPLAIN without saying what it decides, and do not notice the ticket already shows the SELECT is only ~1.4 s of a 6.4 s p50 (F8); accept the 60 s response cache as a cheap stopgap alongside the algorithmic fixes rather than after them, or reject the worker bump without a material reason such as 4,800 pg connections (F9); report both unbounded structures as confirmed leaks instead of saying the artifacts do not show which one drives the RSS growth, when a back-of-envelope shows _request_timings alone is ~70 MB/worker (F10); and read the proposal's cache key without noticing that the default since is a moving now()-30d, so the key as written never hits for the mobile client (F11).
